name: savoir-properties
description: Search, compare and shortlist Savoir Properties' Dubai listings and off-plan projects.

interface.longDescription:
Search the live property portfolio of Savoir Properties, a Dubai real-estate brokerage, directly in ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Find apartments, villas, townhouses, penthouses and offices for sale or rent across Dubai, filtered by area, budget in AED, bedrooms, property type and ready or off-plan status. When nothing matches exactly, you see clearly labelled close alternatives.
- Not sure where to look? Get an area guide with live listing counts and price ranges for your budget.
- Open a listing for photos, price per sq ft, size, amenities, reference and permit numbers, and similar properties.
- Compare up to four listings side by side, including how each one fits the requirements you gave.
- Save listings to a shortlist, reopen it later in the same chat, and create a read-only share link to send to family or a partner.
- Explore off-plan projects with starting prices and published payment plans, and see what each stage would cost for a unit price you enter.
- Prepare a message to Savoir about the listings you like, with a reference code, and send it yourself on WhatsApp or by email.

All information comes from Savoir's own listings system and is shown as published. Prices and availability must be confirmed with a Savoir consultant. The app does not book viewings, take payments or ask for your name, phone number or email, and nothing is sent to Savoir unless you send the prepared message yourself. Shortlists hold listing references only and are deleted 30 days after the last change.

positive.description: Search by area, purpose and bedrooms returns real listings as cards.
positive.prompt: Find 2-bedroom apartments for sale in Dubai Marina.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_properties with areas [Dubai Marina], purpose buy, bedrooms 2. Shows listing cards with photo, AED price, a status such as "For sale · Ready", location, bed/bath, and Details and WhatsApp buttons, plus a short text summary. No invented listings.

positive.description: Opening a listing shows its full details.
positive.prompt: Tell me more about the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_property_details with the first result's slug. Shows a photo gallery, price and price per sq ft, size, status, and under More details the reference and permit numbers, agent and amenities; similar listings follow, labelled when their sale/rent purpose differs.

positive.prompt: Compare the first two listings for me.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_listings with both slugs. Shows a comparison of price, price per sq ft, bedrooms, size, location and how each fits the stated requirements, with the remaining rows under Show all details. Data is re-checked live; nothing is invented.

positive.prompt: Save the first two to my shortlist and give me a share link.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls update_shortlist (creating a shortlist) and share_shortlist. Shows "My shortlist (2)" with both listings and a link of the form https://mcp.savoirproperties.com/s/<token> that opens a read-only Savoir page listing the two properties with no personal details. Explains the shortlist is kept for 30 days and can be reopened in the same chat.

positive.prompt: I'd like to contact Savoir about these two listings.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls prepare_inquiry with the listings. Shows a prepared message containing the listings and a SAV- reference code, with Send on WhatsApp and Send by email buttons. States that nothing is sent until the user sends it and that this is not a booking.

negative.description: Location with no Savoir listings: the app says there is no exact match and does not invent listings.
negative.prompt: Find villas for sale on the Moon.

negative.description: Booking request: the app cannot book viewings; the assistant explains this and offers to prepare a message instead, without claiming a booking.
negative.prompt: Book me a viewing for this apartment tomorrow at 5pm.

negative.description: Unrelated request: no Savoir tool is called.
